title: signed 2x4 circuits compiled to the Quantinuum native gate set, proven equal to their IR by local equivalence and costed (prompts/35 T1)

criteria.name: Q1L (prompts/35a R2) on every built circuit, recomputed from the frozen files: (i) per-qubit two-qubit skeleton identical, two-qubit angles within 1e-11 half-turns; (ii) one-qubit segment products to 1e-12 against the IR with pytket's stored angles; (iii) rounding bound B < 1e-10; q[k]->c[k], identity permutation, native op set

criteria.name: Q1S recorded per circuit: the sparse statevector of the native circuit vs the exact coarse state (state_verified_ids / deferred_ids; a verified circuit must meet max abs(dpsi) < 1e-10, leakage < 1e-9; consistency max abs(dpsi) <= B + 1e-12 recorded, prompts/35a R2)

frozen.selection_rule: fewest ZZ gates among the levels that pass Q1L (local equivalence to the transpiled IR, quantinuum_native.local_equivalence_35a: prompts/35a R2 (i)-(iii), q[k] -> c[k], identity permutation); ties: fewer PhasedX, then the lower level; if no level passes, the pure rebase AutoRebase({Rz, PhasedX, ZZPhase}) (compile_mode 'pure_rebase'); level 2 not attempted at 2x4 (prompts/35a R4)

Q1L.what_it_proves: native circuit == the IR after the prototype transpile (qiskit opt 3, seed 7) up to pytket's angle canonicalisation, whose effect on the state is bounded by B; the transpile itself is verified by statevector at 2x2 (Q0P_2x2 Q1) and 2x3 (Q0P_2x3 Q1) and at 2x4 only through Q1S / QV_2x4_K1..K4

Q2.note: prompts/35a R1: gate_S2D.circuit_set(L) = CircuitFactory.coarse_step(r, k, dt) (src/skqd/circuits_ir.py L898) is ONE coarse step at the angle k dt, the same skeleton for every k, so rzz_before is equal to the family's k = 1 value on every circuit (per reference and across references, as at 2x3: validation/Q0P_2x3.json Q2)

endianness.convention: pytket BackendResult.get_counts(): 'Toggle between ILO (increasing lexicographic order of bit ids) and DLO (decreasing lexicographic order) for column ordering if cbits is None. Defaults to BasisOrder.ilo.' (pytket 2.18.4 docstring); tuple index k = c[k] = qubit k

data.what_pass_means: every built 2x4 circuit is proven equal to its IR by local equivalence (Q1L); the statevector check (Q1S) was reached on 0 of 19 circuits on the laptop and is the deferred GPU tokens QV_2x4_K1..K4 for the rest; not a device statement; no Quantinuum device can run these circuits at the signed clean-shot fraction (Q5)
